dedupe_keys.name: firm level greenhouse gas emissions of wastewater treatment plants in china 2006 2019

description: This dataset is a firm-level greenhouse gas emission inventory of municipal wastewater treatment plants and other wastewater treatment facilities in China for 2006 to 2019, described in a Scientific Data descriptor. For 57,060 facilities it gives methane, nitrous oxide and carbon dioxide from biological treatment processes, carbon dioxide from electricity consumption, and emissions from effluent discharge, in 400,512 records including annual national inventories computed with IPCC 2019 methods. Coverage is China, yearly. The data are a free download from figshare under CC BY 4.0 as one Excel workbook of about 10 MB. Caveats: emissions are estimated, not measured, using emission factors for 48 treatment technologies taken from the literature, with some from IPCC 2019 or laboratory studies. Simulation uses: comparing treatment processes and energy use of plants for decarbonisation planning and operational optimisation. Related records: HydroWASTE, a global treatment plant database (data-hydrowaste), and the European municipal treatment plant database (data-sfi-municipal-wwtp-database-europe).
